description: The first section of this file is identical to the 40 filter types available in 'evi_biquads_coeffs.genexpr', but with all coefficients calculators adjusted to accept audio samplerate as a parameter so that all of these coefficients calculators can be used at schedular rate in gen (no tilde) for huge efficiency savings when circumstances allow. @see the [evi.biquadcoeff] abstraction for the example of how this is done. The rest of this file is a repeat of 'evi_biquads_selectors', similarly adjusted for gen (no tilde) usage. All functions are named identically to their ~ equivelents, but have an additional 'AUDIO_SR' parameter so audio samplerate can be passed in.
